howToAdd: Designers own this pack. To add or edit locally without touching agent code: copy this file to .graphify/recipes.json (it overlays the starter pack by id). Add an object to recipes[]. Reuse an id to replace a starter recipe. Leave defaultMasterId off unless that master already exists in the ingested graph — never invent a Figma node id. Unbound slots are filled by recommend from role + hints.

recipes.title: Checkout summary
recipes.notes: Totals and line items plus a primary pay action. The primary button slot defaults to Pay CTA when that master is in the library. Optional field for promo or email.

recipes.title: Settings form
recipes.notes: Labeled fields with a save action. Bind defaultMasterId after ingest if your Input/Button ids are stable.

recipes.title: Search results
recipes.notes: Search bar, a results list, and an empty / no-results state.

recipes.title: Empty state
recipes.notes: Message plus one action. Do not place deprecated banners; recommend a live master.

recipes.title: List and detail
recipes.notes: Collection row plus a detail card and an action.

recipes.title: Sign in
recipes.notes: Identifier and secret fields plus submit. Same Input master may fill both field slots.

recipes.title: Confirm dialog
recipes.notes: Short body with a primary confirm and optional secondary cancel.

recipes.title: Nav and content shell
recipes.notes: Page chrome around a content master. Optional page action.
